_comment: chirp airband daemon defaults. Phase 4a defaults + Phase 4b 'sdr' block. 'sdr' is consulted only when CHIRP_SOURCE=sdr (or source='sdr' here). All keys are optional and can be overridden by the matching CHIRP_* env var. See chirp/config/README.md.

sdr._comment: SDR source defaults for airband. SB7 (M1, macOS): RSPduo RSP-B serial 1809063632 in SINGLE-TUNER mode (rspduo_mode=ST) — the proven-clean config (2026-06-15). Master mode (mode=MA) corrupts the IQ into broadband noise; ST is the structural kill-shot. Uses SoapySDRPlay3 arg keys rspduo_mode/rspduo_tuner (NOT osmosdr's mode/tuner). center_freq_hz is retuned by the LO scheduler to cover the airband list.
